breaking_news.headline: Why these 5 everyday items fluctuate in price at the grocery store
breaking_news.summary: Here's what's behind the fluctuating costs of everyday grocery items such as ground beef, eggs and chocolate chip cookies.

breaking_news.headline: What if an AI bubble bursts — and that accelerates AI job losses?
breaking_news.summary: Research on past recessions suggests downturns can accelerate automation. That raises the specter of a double whammy for workers.

breaking_news.headline: FAA clears the way for airlines to put Boeing's long-delayed 737 Max 10 into service
breaking_news.summary: Nearly a decade after Boeing unveiled its largest 737 Max jet, the company has cleared a major hurdle in its effort to bring the plane to airlines.

breaking_news.headline: Netflix holds quarterly earnings call following leadership shakeup and layoffs
breaking_news.summary: Netflix reported its latest quarterly earnings on Tuesday. It comes as the streaming company has announced a management shakeup and layoffs of more than 1,000 employees.

breaking_news.headline: Elon Musk says Space X and Tesla are considering a merger
breaking_news.summary: CEO Elon Musk says both Space X and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss the idea of a merger, but a merger would require approval of 50% of shareholders.

breaking_news.headline: How long does it take to save up for a starter home? Twice as long as it did in 2019
breaking_news.summary: A new analysis finds that the average renter household now needs 16 years to save for a down payment and closing costs. Rising rents and other costs have consumed a growing share of household budgets.

breaking_news.headline: See how Big Tech is transforming Spain's landscape
breaking_news.summary: A drought-stricken region of northeast Spain has become a focus for American companies searching for locations to place their data centers.

breaking_news.headline: Achy from sitting at a desk all day? Try doing this
breaking_news.summary: Sitting at a desk all day hurts. And it isn't good for us. Strategies to make it a little more comfortable, from eye muscle exercises to alleviate eye strain to a back pain-fighting body movement.

breaking_news.headline: Germany target of 'intensive' espionage, Merz says after suspected Russian spy arrest
breaking_news.summary: A Ukrainian man was arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia - one of several such cases in Germany this year.

breaking_news.headline: Crowd of 50 beats foreigner to death in South Africa
breaking_news.summary: The attack on the unidentified victim follows a wave of anti-migrants protests in South Africa this year.

breaking_news.headline: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
breaking_news.summary: Websites were taken offline after the developers of programming language PHP said "critical vulnerabilities" had been discovered.

breaking_news.headline: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
breaking_news.summary: Trump is suing the BBC over an episode of Panorama that edited together two different sections of a speech he gave in 2021.

breaking_news.headline: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
breaking_news.summary: Raghad and Raad's family had to flee their home on foot because of the fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.

breaking_news.headline: Trump says Musk has restored access to Ukraine's Starlink network
breaking_news.summary: Ukraine relies on Starlink for a range of military uses - its owner Elon Musk has repeatedly denied restricting access.

breaking_news.headline: Hospitals deliberately targeted by Sudan's RSF fighters, BBC investigation finds
breaking_news.summary: The UN human rights chief Volker Türk says the multiple attacks may amount to war crimes.

breaking_news.headline: What is PHP and why did it spark a global cyber-security scramble?
breaking_news.summary: AI uncovered long-hidden programming flaws, triggering a rare global cyber-security response.

breaking_news.headline: The 'trillion pound' oil fund the government believes Britain could have built
breaking_news.summary: For the first time, the Treasury calculates how much the UK could have raised by investing North Sea proceeds.

breaking_news.headline: Tank barrel production returns to UK after 20 years
breaking_news.summary: The defence secretary says the UK is "back in the business of making weapons" for its armed forces.

breaking_news.headline: Barclays cutting 5,000 jobs as it increases reliance on AI
breaking_news.summary: The bank says it is using more AI leading to a 5% reduction in its workforce.

breaking_news.headline: 'I wasn't thinking straight' says five jobs civil servant
breaking_news.summary: Kashim Chowdhury is accused of fraudulently juggling multiple public sector jobs.
